cues.en: Welcome to Electron Online. In this series of videos starting with this one, we're going to talk about the Kalman filter.
cues.zh: 欢迎来到 Electron Online。从本期开始的一系列视频中，我们将讨论卡尔曼滤波器。

cues.en: Now the Kalman filter is an amazing tool in order to estimate predicted values,
cues.zh: 卡尔曼滤波器是估计预测值的强大工具，

cues.en: But it's sometimes very difficult to understand how the calmin filter actually works. So therefore
cues.zh: 但有时很难理解卡尔曼滤波器实际是如何工作的。因此

cues.en: I made some videos to describe what a calmin filter actually is. How to use it with some nice examples. So follow this.
cues.zh: 我制作了一些视频，介绍卡尔曼滤波器究竟是什么、如何配合一些不错的示例使用。那就接着看吧。

cues.en: So what is a Kalman filter? Well, it is an iterative
cues.zh: 那么什么是卡尔曼滤波器？它是一种迭代式的

cues.en: mathematical
cues.zh: 数学

cues.en: process. It's so you you follow a set of iterations.
cues.zh: 过程。也就是说，你要遵循一组迭代步骤。

cues.en: It's a mathematical process that uses a set of equations.
cues.zh: 它是一种使用一组方程的数学过程。

cues.en: Those equations
cues.zh: 这些方程

cues.en: and consecutive data inputs. So we get a data input, we use the equation, we calculate the new estimate, we get another data input, we calculate the new estimate, we get another data input, we calculate the new estimate again. It's an iterative process.
cues.zh: 以及连续的数据输入。我们收到一个数据输入，就用方程计算新的估计值；再收到一个数据输入，再计算新的估计值；再来一个数据输入，就再算一次。这是一个迭代过程。

cues.en: And the reason for doing it like this is so that we can quickly estimate the true value.
cues.zh: 这样做是为了能快速估计出真实值。

cues.en: So let's say that we have 50 or 100 data points that come in one at a time.
cues.zh: 假设我们有 50 或 100 个数据点，一次一个地输入。

cues.en: And you have... You could... And yes, we could do a, for example, a distribution of these values and find the average value and then say well the average value must be very close to the true value. But in order to do that we need to have a whole bunch of inputs already.
cues.zh: 你可以……是的，我们可以比如对这些值做分布，求平均值，然后说平均值一定非常接近真实值。但要做到这一点，我们已经需要有一大堆输入。

cues.en: The Kelman filter doesn't wait for a whole bunch of inputs. It very quickly starts to narrow in to the true value by taking a few of those inputs and by understanding
cues.zh: 卡尔曼滤波器不会等一大堆输入。它只取其中少数几个输入，并通过理解

cues.en: the variation or the uncertainty of those inputs, those data inputs.
cues.zh: 这些输入、这些数据输入的波动或不确定性，迅速开始逼近真实值。

cues.en: So it
cues.zh: 所以它

cues.en: quickly estimates
cues.zh: 快速估算

cues.en: the true value, position, velocity, whatever it is that we're trying to measure
cues.zh: 真实值、位置、速度，或者我们想要测量的任何量

cues.en: of the object that's being measured when
cues.zh: 正在被测量的对象，当

cues.en: the measured values contain unpredicted
cues.zh: 测量值中包含未预测的内容

cues.en: or random errors, uncertainties or variations
cues.zh: 或随机错误、不确定性或变化

cues.en: as well. So remember that the data coming in is not the true value, it's somewhere around the true value with a certain amount of uncertainty.
cues.zh: 所以也要记住，传入的数据并非真实值，而是围绕真实值、带有一定不确定性的近似值。

cues.en: And of course since that can bounce all over the place, it would be very difficult to any other system to try and figure out what the true value is or come very close to the true value.
cues.zh: 当然，因为它可能到处乱跳，其他系统要想弄清楚真实值是多少，甚至只是接近真实值，都会非常困难。

cues.en: So a very simple example here in the graphical sense can help you understand that. Let's say we're trying to measure the temperature with a certain thermometer.
cues.zh: 这里有一个很直观的图表示例能帮你理解这一点。假设我们要用某种温度计来测量温度。

cues.en: That thermometer is not very accurate. It has a certain amount of uncertainty in the data measurements.
cues.zh: 那个温度计不太准，它的测量数据存在一定的不确定性。

cues.en: Let's say that the vertical axis here means temperature.
cues.zh: 假设这里的纵轴表示温度。

cues.en: The horizontal axis means time or consecutive sample inputs.
cues.zh: 横轴表示时间或连续的样本输入。

cues.en: The little crosses here are consecutive inputs. So here the temperature is measured to be this high, and to be this high, to be this high, to be this high, then this. So you can see that the temperature measured time and again always varies because there's certain amount of uncertainty in that temperature measurement technique for whatever reason it may be. And so therefore it would take a very long time for us to average these values out. The Kelman filter can do it a lot faster.
cues.zh: 这里的小叉号代表连续的输入。可以看到，这里测得的温度是这么高，接着是这么高、这么高、这么高，然后是这个。所以你能看到，不论出于什么原因，这种测温技术总存在一定的不确定性，导致每次测出的温度都在变化。因此，如果我们想把这些数值平均掉，会花上很长时间。而卡尔曼滤波器的处理速度要快得多。

cues.en: It starts out by taking an initial estimate. It almost doesn't matter what the initial estimate is.
cues.zh: 一开始先取一个初始估计值。初始估计值是什么几乎无所谓。

cues.en: And of course in your estimate you have to predict a certain amount of error or uncertainty.
cues.zh: 当然，在估计中你必须预测一定量的误差或不确定性。

cues.en: But very quickly as data points start coming in and we go through that iterative process,
cues.zh: 但随着数据点开始涌入，我们经过那个迭代过程，很快

cues.en: the count and filter actually narrows down to somewhere close to the true value very quickly. It doesn't take very many data points to get there. Once you get there, as more and more data points come in, the variations will become very very small,
cues.zh: 计数和过滤实际上会很快收敛到接近真实值的地方。不需要很多数据点就能达到。一旦达到，随着越来越多数据点进来，波动会变得非常非常小，

cues.en: and the predicted value through the Kelvin filter process will be very very close to the actual temperature in this case, in this example. So the estimated temperature using the Kelvin filter will zero in and come very very close to the actual temperature very quickly. Now in this example here, there's only one measured value we're after, the temperature.
cues.zh: 在这个例子中，通过卡尔曼滤波过程预测的值会非常非常接近实际温度。所以用卡尔曼滤波估计的温度会迅速锁定并非常接近实际温度。现在这个例子中，我们只追踪一个测量值，温度。

cues.en: However, this can be used especially like in radar technology
cues.zh: 然而，这可以用于尤其是像雷达技术

cues.en: or
cues.zh: 或

cues.en: GPS tracking satellites.
cues.zh: GPS追踪卫星。

cues.en: We need to know the target that we're tracking. We need to know its position in the x direction, the position in the y direction, the velocity in the x direction, the velocity in the y direction. And yes, the Kalman filter can very quickly again to the very same process
cues.zh: 我们需要知道我们正在追踪的目标。我们需要知道它在x方向的位置、y方向的位置、x方向的速度、y方向的速度。是的，卡尔曼滤波可以再次非常快速地通过同样的过程

cues.en: narrow it down, narrow these intermediate values that come in which can be all over the place because as you're trying to track airplanes via radar or target via radar, you're trying to track satellites.
cues.zh: 缩小范围，缩小这些进来的中间值，这些值可能到处都是，因为当你试图通过雷达追踪飞机或通过雷达追踪目标时，你试图追踪卫星。

cues.en: That's not an exact science. The data coming in will have certain amount of uncertainty in it, and the Kalman filter can very easily handle that uncertainty
cues.zh: 这不是一门精确的科学。输入的数据本身会带有一定的不确定性，而卡尔曼滤波可以非常轻松地处理这种不确定性

cues.en: and very quickly zero in on the true position and the true velocity of the object that you're tracking.
cues.zh: 并且能以极快的速度锁定你正在追踪的物体的真实位置和真实速度。

cues.en: Of course if we're looking for something like this where we have multiple data inputs that we have to converge at the same time, it's a little different process than if we take a singular value like the temperature measured by the thermometer.
cues.zh: 当然，如果我们寻找的是这种需要让多个数据输入同时收敛的情况，它和处理温度计测量的温度这种单一数值的过程会有点不同。

cues.en: What that means is that when we track satellites or airplanes,
cues.zh: 这意味着当我们追踪卫星或飞机时，

cues.en: we'll have to use instead of using a single number system and a simple set of equations, we'll have to use equations using
cues.zh: 我们不能使用单一的数字系统和简单的方程组，而是必须使用包含

cues.en: of course matrices
cues.zh: 矩阵的方程，

cues.en: and we'll show you how to do that as well. But to get the technique down first, we're going to start with a very simple example like this. Just simply measuring the temperature
cues.zh: 我们也会向你展示如何做到这一点。但为了先掌握这个技术，我们要从这样一个非常简单的例子开始。也就是简单地测量温度

cues.en: and see how Kelman filter can very quickly zoom in to that actual temperature that we're trying to figure out. And then once we have that technique down, that will expand it to the more complicated set of equations to be used to figure out how to track targets like using radar or how to use GPS tracking,
cues.zh: 看看卡尔曼滤波如何非常迅速地逼近我们试图找出的实际温度。一旦我们掌握了这个技术，就会把它扩展到更复杂的方程组，用来弄清楚如何追踪目标，比如使用雷达或如何进行GPS追踪，
